name: Guanyu Wo Bei Xiaoxue Nvsheng Bangjia Zhe Jian Shi
original_name: 关于我被小学女生绑架这件事
source: On a day during summer break, you (a teacher) wander into the empty school buildings and find a little girl who's alone. As a self-proclaimed Lolicon, you can't help but feel excited and thrilled about this unexpected encounter. However, there seems to be something strange about this little girl you just met...
translation: 暑假的一天，你（一名老师）漫步在空荡荡的教学楼里，发现了一个孤独的小女孩。作为一个自诩为萝莉控的你，对于这次不期而遇的邂逅，不禁感到兴奋和激动。不过，刚刚认识的这个小女孩，似乎有些奇怪……
